recognize_zh: 關節液抹片中布滿大量細長針狀結晶，彼此交錯並聚成一束一束，部分與嗜中性球重疊，背景為蛋白性物質與許多嗜中性球；大量針狀結晶伴急性發炎，符合痛風的尿酸鈉（MSU）結晶，確認需以偏光顯微鏡看到強負雙折射。
features: Innumerable slender needle-shaped crystals, extracellular and overlying cells, forming a dense criss-crossing meshwork
Crystals aggregating into parallel bundles (upper and center of field)
Many neutrophils with segmented nuclei, several with vacuolated cytoplasm
A macrophage with blue-gray cytoplasm and a cell containing phagocytosed pyknotic nuclear fragments
describe_en: Wright-stained synovial fluid preparation shows a neutrophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate embedded in proteinaceous material with innumerable slender needle-shaped crystals, both extracellular and overlying cells, many aggregated into parallel bundles. A macrophage and a phagocyte containing pyknotic nuclear fragments are also present. No organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with monosodium urate crystals in acute gouty arthritis; confirmation by compensated polarized light microscopy showing strongly negatively birefringent needles is recommended, and concurrent septic arthritis should be excluded by culture.

ddx.vs: CPPD crystals are short rhomboid or rod-shaped and weakly positively birefringent, not long, fine, strongly negatively birefringent needles.
Steroid crystals are irregular, blunt or jagged and of variable size, with a history of recent intra-articular injection.
Cholesterol crystals are large flat rectangular plates with notched corners rather than slender needles.
Septic arthritis also yields a neutrophil-rich fluid but shows organisms on Gram stain or culture and lacks abundant crystals; the two may coexist.
